Measured scoped bytes equal #646's pins and saved baseline `a59d88d529a705ed62c3c8ea800bc8b39b8fd97c`, tree `53578af3d8d3835ff3b56e6e6a69891c8dcfc4aa`; scoped diff is empty. `f7066e7` is unavailable locally, without preventing byte identity.
The #646 input matches required SHA256 `4de32e516c08655a629dbb187842caa4ab82ecb7e5d2ed5e00c0084bf0151b83`; all four exports are available. [Evidence ledger](artifacts/project-run-binding-review-0140.json) records measured pins, source pointers, controls and findings.
## Standards

**CLEAR:** no documented naming, duplication, abstraction or scope violation in these files; whitespace check passes. Existing schemas, keys and preparation index remain unchanged; no repository fixes made.
## Spec

**NOT-CLEAR — F1, medium/P2:** [linkage](../benchmark/verify_project_run_binding_0138.py:179) checks each record against its slot, while [accounting](../benchmark/verify_project_run_binding_0138.py:274) never verifies a common case/pair group.
Coordinately split the tool arm's `pair_id` or `case_id` across plan/record/attempt and refresh plan hashes: both probes yield linkage **pass** and **one** structurally complete synthetic pair; expected rejection and **zero**, because each group lacks its opposite arm. [Saved counterexamples and results](artifacts/independent-probe-results-0140.json).
This is a structural control weakness; the unconditional real-admission block remains intact. Independent probes meet 30/32 expectations, with exactly those two failures.
Independent byte coverage is six leaves, 24 fragments, 1,631 bytes; the narrative mappings otherwise preserve exact synthetic envelopes, eight mandatory nulls, manifest byte-only binding and empty/malformed interrupted-response rejection.
Correctness and grounding retain separate D1–D4 denominators of four; fidelity remains unavailable and unknown costs remain null. Sidecar linkage and retry preservation remain design-only.
Separate repository verification `python3 -I benchmark/verify_project_run_binding_0138.py`: **exit 0, 49/49 saved controls match**; this does not resolve F1 or establish CLEAR.
[#643](exports/reports/643.json) attributes the prohibited evaluator invocation to the parent continuation; [#646](exports/reports/646.json) preserves it. No verification credit; original deviation artifact unavailable, uninspected and unreconstructed. #639/#636 were used only for lineage.
**Actual real admissions, model/reader/native executions, scored runs, semantic passes and complete pairs: all zero.** No benchmark readiness, owner acceptance or measured product gain.
## What next

Smallest correction: enforce valid same-case/same-pair plan grouping and group-derived completion accounting; add predeclared coordinated split-case/split-pair controls and refresh affected pins/outcomes within these same three files.
Then independently review that bounded diff using the saved probe and counterexamples. Preserve old contracts and admission blocks; avoid source sweeps, closed-review replay, evaluator/builders and real execution.
Model/quota/budgets, frozen repetitions/stopping, reader/probes/native alignment, trusted isolation/storage/model/usage verification, scorer integration, independent method review and owner acceptance remain substantive method gaps.
